title: DC’s Ultimate National Mall Tour: DC By Moonlight
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore the National Mall under the enchanting moonlight, where iconic landmarks come to life. With guided visits to the Washington Monument, WWII Memorial, and Martin Luther King Jr. Memorial, this tour offers a unique perspective of DC's historical significance. Parents can relax, allowing families to focus on creating memorable moments together instead of managing logistics. The tour is adaptable based on everyone’s pace, ensuring everyone stays engaged and curious throughout the journey.

- Guided evening tour covering major monuments and memorials
- Family-friendly, with a focus on storytelling and interactive moments
- Flexible pacing tailored to your family’s interests and energy levels
